c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

说.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 兑 represents the sound.
w: to speak; to say; to talk
to explain; to illustrate; to indicate
to hear (sth said); one hears (that); hearsay
to state; to say (the quoted words)
x: 这就是我所说的。
Zhè jiù shì wǒ suǒ shuō de.
That’s what I said.
这个人说话太霸气了！
Zhè ge rén shuōhuà tài bàqì le!
The way this person speaks is too aggressive!
这说明什么？
Zhè shuōmíng shénme?
What does this show?

年.o: Pictograph of a person (人) harvesting grain (禾). The harvest season is a yearly event.
w: a decade of a century (e.g. the Sixties); age
x: 您今年贵庚？
Nín jīnnián guìgēng?
How old are you this year? [to an unfamiliar elderly person]
其实我觉得吧，他还是太年轻了。
Qíshí wǒ juéde ba, tā háishì tài niánqīng le.
Actually, I think he is still too young.
她去年嫁给了大学同学。
Tā qùnián jià gěi le dàxué tóngxué.
She married her university classmate last year.

訴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 斥 represents the sound.

间.o: Simplified form of 間. Depicts sunlight (日) shining through the gap in a door (門).
w: period of time; time; time period
in an instant; in a flash
x: 两点间直线最短。
Liǎng diǎn jiān zhíxiàn zuì duǎn.
The shortest distance between two points is a straight line.
时间还来得及。
Shíjiān hái láidejí.
All in good time.
这两个之间到底有什么样的区别？
Zhè liǎng ge zhījiān dàodǐ yǒu shénmeyàng de qūbié?
What is the difference between these two?

c.h: Depicts a head on top of a person.

头.o: Phonosemantic compound. 頁 represents the meaning and 豆 represents the sound. The simplified character 头 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 頭.
w: to turn round; to turn one's head; later
camera lens; camera shot (in a movie etc)
x: 我头不再痛了。
Wǒ tóu bùzài tòng le.
My head doesn't hurt any more.
我把头发染成了粉的。
Wǒ bǎ tóufà rǎn chéng le fěn de.
I dyed my hair pink.
回头见！
Huítóu jiàn!
See you later!

c.h: The purpose of this component is unclear.

直.o: Pictograph of a straight line coming from the eye, to depict looking straight at something. The purpose of the stroke at the bottom is unclear.
x: 他直起腰来，手背在后面。
Tā zhí qǐ yāo lái, shǒu bèi zài hòumiàn.
He straightened up, hands on his back.
我一直很头痛这个事。
Wǒ yīzhí hěn tóutòng zhè ge shì.
I have long been annoyed with this.
他让我直接联系局长。
Tā ràng wǒ zhíjiē liánxì júzhǎng.
He asked me to contact the director directly.

水.o: Depicts the flow of water in a river.
w: to dive; to go under water
x: 请给我一杯水，谢谢。
Qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ, xièxiè.
A glass of water, please.
他的技术水平绝对不在专家之下。
Tā de jìshù shuǐpíng juéduì bù zài zhuānjiā zhīxià.
His technical skill is definitely not inferior to that of a specialist.
这个水晶很值钱。
Zhège shuǐjīng hěn zhíqián.
This crystal is very valuable.

c.h: Depicts a hand holding a whip.
Used here to depict a chariot.

更.o: Depicts using a whip (攴) to control a succession of chariots (丙). 丙 also represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "continue; succession". The meaning later shifted to "further" and "more".
w: to replace the old with new; to renew
to change; to alter; to modify
change room; dressing room; locker room
x: 加拿大的房子比美国的更贵。
Jiānádà de fángzi bǐ Měiguó de gèng guì.
Canadian homes are even more expensive than American homes.
双方经合意变更原契约内容。
Shuāngfāng jīng héyì biàngēng yuán qìyuē nèiróng.
Both parties agree to change the content of the original contract.
我的裙子更漂亮！
Wǒ de qúnzi gèng piàoliang!
My skirt is even more beautiful!

場.o: Phonosemantic compound. 土 represents the meaning and 昜 represents the sound.

却.o: Phonosemantic compound. 卩 represents the meaning and 去 represents the sound. Simplified form of 卻.
x: 我喜欢你，却不敢表达。
Wǒ xǐhuān nǐ, què bùgǎn biǎodá.
I love you, but I do not have the courage to express it.
那段时光是我所无法忘却的。
Nà duàn shíguāng shì wǒ suǒ wúfǎ wàngquè de.
Those times were unforgettable.

c.h: Shorthand for the 舁 component in the traditional character 興. Depicts four hands.
Shorthand for the 同 component in the traditional character 興. Depicts something being lifted.

兴.o: Depicts four hands (舁) working together (同) to raise something. The simplified character 兴 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 興.
w: interest (desire to know about sth); hobby
(of markets, industries, infectious diseases etc) rising
x: 我很高兴听到那个消息。
Wǒ hěn gāoxìng tīng dào nà ge xiāoxi.
I'm happy to hear that.
我是对这些没什么兴趣。
Wǒ shì duì zhèxiē méishénme xìngqù.
I have no interest in any of these.
我去他家的时候，心情总是兴奋和担忧各半。
Wǒ qù tā jiā de shíhòu, xīnqíng zǒngshì xīngfèn hé dānyōu gèbàn.
When I go to his place I always feel excited and worried in equal measure.

整.o: Phonosemantic compound. 敕 represents the meaning and 正 represents the sound.
w: to arrange; to tidy up; to sort out
x: 她没有整过容。
Tā méiyǒu zhěng guò róng.
She has not had plastic surgery.
整个世界都是由物质组成的。
Zhěngge shìjiè dōu shì yóu wùzhì zǔchéng de.
The entire world is made up of matter.
整栋楼的人都在睡觉。
Zhěng dòng lóu de rén dōu zài shuìjiào.
The people in the entire building are sleeping.

巴.o: Depicts a person grabbing something with their hand. Original form of 把. In modern Chinese this character is usually used only for its sound.
w: palm of the hand; classifier: slap
large bus; coach; (abbr. for 大型巴士)
x: 小狗摇着尾巴跑了。
Xiǎo gǒu yáo zhe wěiba pǎo le.
The little dog ran off wagging its tail.
他的车撞上了巴士。
Tā de chē zhuàngshàngle bāshì.
His car collided with the bus.
小狗摇著尾巴跑了。
Xiǎo gǒu yáo zhe wěiba pǎo le.
The little dog ran off wagging its tail.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

维.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 隹 represents the sound. Simplified form of 維.
w: to defend; to safeguard; to protect
to keep; to maintain; to preserve
x: 正在维修。
Zhèngzài wéixiū.
Under repair.
记得多吃苹果哦，补充维他命。
Jìde duō chī píngguǒ o, bǔchōng wéitāmìng.
Remember to eat more apples to get more vitamins.

c.h: 攵 is a component form of 攴.

致.o: Phonosemantic compound. 攵 represents the meaning and 至 represents the sound.
w: to lead to; to create; to cause
to salute; to pay one's respects to
x: 长期泡在冰水里会导致体温过低。
Chángqī pào zài bīngshuǐ lǐ huì dǎozhì tǐwēn guòdī.
Too much time spent in icy water can cause hypothermia.
两次输入的密码不一致。
Liǎng cì shūrù de mìmǎ bù yīzhì.
The two passwords that you entered are inconsistent.
路上坑坑洼洼的，骑车的人一不小心就有致命危险。
Lùshàng kēngkēngwāwā de, qíchē de rén yībùxiǎoxīn jiù yǒu zhìmìng wēixiǎn.
Pot holes can be lethal for the unwary cyclist.

嘴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 觜 represents the sound.
w: mouth; in the mouth; on one's lips
to hold one's tongue; Shut up!
Shut up!; same as 闭上嘴巴
x: 闭嘴，我怎么说你就怎么办！
Bìzuǐ, wǒ zěnme shuō nǐ jiù zěnme bàn!
Shut up and do what I say!
你给我闭嘴！
Nǐ gěi wǒ bìzuǐ!
Shut the heck up!

嚴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 喦 represents the meaning and 敢 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "exaggerate". The meaning later shifted to "extreme", "severe", and "strict".

围.o: Phonosemantic compound. 囗 represents the meaning and 韦 represents the sound.
w: to surround; to encircle; to hem in
to revolve around; to center on (an issue)
to stand in a circle and watch
x: 这超出我们的服务范围。
Zhè chāochū wǒmen de fúwù fànwéi.
We do not offer this service.
好像他根本就不认识周围的任何人。
Hǎoxiàng tā gēnběn jiù bù rènshi zhōuwéi de rènhé rén.
It seems he does not recognize any people around him.

破.o: Phonosemantic compound. 石 represents the meaning and 皮 represents the sound.
w: to break through; to make a breakthrough
to go bankrupt; to become impoverished
to rupture; to fracture; to break down
to solve a case; shabby old table
to smash to pieces; to shatter
x: 她要求他们为她破个例。
Tā yāoqiú tāmen wèi tā pò ge lì.
She asked them to make an exception for her.
真不好意思，让你破费了。
Zhēn bùhǎoyìsi, ràng nǐ pòfèi le.
I'm so sorry for putting you to the expense.

c.h: 糹 is a component form of 糸.

練.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 柬 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "boil and scour raw silk" to make it softer and whiter. The meaning later shifted to "to make perfect" and "to practice".

c.h: Depicts two hands putting something on top of the head.

戴.o: Depicts two hands putting something on top of the head (異). The 𢦏 and 異 components both represent the sound.
w: to love and respect; love and respect
to wear a hat; to stigmatize
(of enemies) cannot live under the same sky
x: 上门提亲，穿戴一定要整齐，要有礼貌。
Shàngmén tíqīn, chuāndài yīdìng yào zhěngqí, yào yǒu lǐmào.
When you visit to propose marriage, you must dress neatly and be polite.
我可以叫他戴夫吗？
Wǒ kěyǐ jiào tā Dàifū ma?
May I call him Dave?

c.h: Here used to depict a pile of objects.

临.o: Simplified form of 臨. Depicts a person (人) looking (臣) down at a pile of objects (品). 品 also represents the sound. Based on the original meaning, "to look down". The meaning has shifted over time and now means "draw near".
w: to face sth; to be confronted with
as the time draws near; at the last moment
to honor with one's presence; to attend
to descend; to arrive; to come
x: 水土流失是这个地区农业生产面临的一个主要问题。
Shuǐtǔ liúshī shì zhège dìqū nóngyè shēngchǎn miànlín de yī gè zhǔyào wèntí.
Erosion is a major issue faced by agricultural production in this region.
临时变更直播时间！
Línshí biàngèng zhíbō shíjiān!
The livestream time has temporarily changed!

c.h: Depicts a shell, used as currency in ancient China.

貴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 㬰 represents the sound.

暴.o: Depicts two hands (共) laying out rice (米) to dry under the sun (日), representing the meaning "expose to sun", now written as 曝. The meaning later shifted to "expose", "injure", and "violent".
w: to expose; to reveal; to lay bare
x: 连日暴雨令这个镇变成泽国。
Liánrì bàoyǔ lìng zhège zhèn biànchéng zéguó.
The prolonged rainstorm has completely flooded this town.
她对网暴者的诉讼被迫停止。
Tā duì wǎngbào zhě de sùsòng bèipò tíngzhǐ.
Her lawsuit against the cyber bulliers was forced to stop.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.
Simplified from the traditional 陰. Used here since the moon corresponds to the 'Yin' of 'Yin and Yang' in Chinese philosophy.

阴.o: The traditional characters 陰 (Yin) and 陽 (Yang) were simplified to 阴 and 阳. In Chinese philosophy, the moon (月) corresponds to Yin (阴) and the sun (日) corresponds to Yang (阳).
x: 天阴了。
Tiān yīn le.
The sky is overcast.
我做过核酸检测了，结果是阴性的。
Wǒ zuò guò hésuān jiǎncè le, jiéguǒ shì yīnxìng de.
I have taken a nucleic acid test, and the result was negative.
我今儿个让人给阴了。
Wǒ jīnrge ràng rén gěi yīn le.
Today I have been tricked by someone.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

伴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 半 represents the sound.
w: to accompany sb; to accompany each other
x: 他是我最好的伙伴。
Tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de huǒbàn.
He is my best companion.
谢谢你一直陪伴着我。
Xièxie nǐ yīzhí péibàn zhe wǒ.
Thank you for always being by my side.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

擴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 廣 represents the sound.

痴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 知 represents the sound. Simplified form of 癡.
w: lit. as if drunk and stupefied (idiom)
to be carried away by one's wishful thinking (idiom)
x: 他对足球非常痴迷。
Tā duì zúqiú fēicháng chīmí.
He is obsessed with football.

吴.o: Simplified form of 吳. Pictograph of a person (天) standing up, yelling with an open mouth (口).
x: 吴老师是我们的班主任。
Wú lǎoshī shì wǒmen de bānzhǔrèn.
Teacher Wu is our homeroom teacher.
小吴今天请假了。
Xiǎo Wú jīntiān qǐngjià le.
Xiao Wu took the day off today.

援.o: To lead 爰 by hand 扌; 爰 also provides the pronunciation
w: to provide assistance; to support; to back
to help; to support; to aid
to save; to support; to help
x: 一方有难，八方支援。
Yīfāng yǒu nán, bāfāng zhīyuán.
When disaster strikes, assistance comes from all sides.
他们用镜子反射阳光，好让救援飞机发现。
Tāmen yòng jìngzǐ fǎnshè yángguāng, hǎo ràng jiùyuán fēijī fāxiàn.
They used a mirror to reflect sunlight and help the search-and-rescue aircraft find them.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

側.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 則 represents the sound.

c.h: In ancient China shells were used as currency.

賴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 剌 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "profit". The meaning later shifted to "rely on" and "blame".

c.h: Depicts a woman slave. Also serves as a phonetic component.
Depicts a hand forcing a slave to do work.

奴.o: Depicts a hand (又) behind a woman (女) slave's back forcing her to work.
x: 奴才给老佛爷请安。
Núcái gěi lǎofóyé qǐng'ān.
We [do hereby] pay respect to Your Majesty.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

浴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 谷 represents the sound.
w: to take a bath; to bathe; to immerse
x: 运动员出水后立刻去淋浴。
Yùndòngyuán chūshuǐ hòu lìkè qù lìnyù.
The athlete immediately went to take a shower after getting out of the water.

c.h: In ancient China shells were used as currency.

贴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 贝 represents the meaning and 占 represents the sound. Simplified form of 貼.
w: paste to, stick on; attached to
worn next to the skin; close-fitting
to press close to; to snuggle close; intimate
x: 禁止张贴广告。
Jìnzhǐ zhāngtiē guǎnggào.
No posters.
他不但细心，而且体贴。
Tā bùdàn xìxīn, érqiě tǐtiē.
He is not only meticulous, but also caring.

c.h: Pictograph of a stringed musical instrument similar to a zither.

琴.o: The top component is a pictograph of a zither-like stringed musical instrument. 今 is a sound component.
w: to play or strum a lute or other stringed instrument
x: 我钢琴弹得不好，见笑了。
Wǒ gāngqín tán de bù hǎo, jiànxiào le.
Please excuse my poor piano performance. [humble]
我不会拉小提琴。
Wǒ bùhuì lā xiǎotíqín.
I don't know how to play the violin.

趴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 八 represents the sound.
x: 小猫趴在沙发上睡觉。
Xiǎomāo pā zài shāfā shàng shuìjiào.
The kitten is sleeping sprawled on the sofa.
他趴在桌子上睡着了。
Tā pā zài zhuōzi shàng shuìzháo le.
He fell asleep slumped over the desk.

婴.o: Simplified form of 嬰. Depicts a woman (女) wearing shell ornaments (賏) around her neck. 賏 also represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "necklace". The meaning of this character has shifted over time and now means "infant" or "baby".
w: to abandon an infant; abandoned baby
x: 母亲疼爱地抚摸著婴儿。
Mǔqīn téng'ài dì fǔmō zhù yīng'ér.
The mother caressed her baby lovingly.
她给婴儿喂了饭，换了尿布。
Tā gěi yīng'ér wèi le fàn, huàn le niàobù.
She fed the baby and changed its nappy.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

渴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 曷 represents the sound.
w: to thirst for; to long for
to long for; to crave for; to greatly desire
x: 他总是渴望给别人留下良好的印象。
Tā zǒngshì kěwàng gěi biérén liúxià liánghǎo de yìnxiàng.
He's always longing to give other people a good impression.
我有一点口渴。
Wǒ yǒu yīdiǎn kǒukě.
I am a little thirsty.
饥饿和口渴的问题可以拖延一下。
Jī'è hé kǒukě de wèntí kěyǐ tuōyán yīxià.
Hunger and thirst can wait.

w: to appraise; to identify; to evaluate
in view of; seeing that; considering
in view of this; to this end
x: 他对古董很有鉴赏力。
Tā duì gǔdǒng hěn yǒu jiànshǎng lì.
He has an eye for antiques.
文革殷鉴不远。
Wéngé yīnjiànbùyuǎn.
The Cultural Revolution is not far past.

鳴.o: The sound 口 a bird 鳥 makes

宴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 妟 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "peace and happiness". The meaning later shifted to "banquet", "feast", and "to entertain".
w: to entertain, feast; a feast, banquet
x: 这次宴会被停电搅黄了。
Zhècì yànhuì bèi tíngdiàn jiǎohuáng le.
This party was derailed due to the blackout.
香港的结婚人情公价按婚宴场地而异。
Xiānggǎng de jiéhūn rénqíng gōngjià àn hūnyàn chǎngdì ér yì.
The price of customary gift money for weddings in Hong Kong varies depending on the venue.

c.h: 釒 is a component form of 金.

鈴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 釒 represents the meaning and 令 represents the sound.

c.h: 犭 is a component form of 犬.

猴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 犭 represents the meaning and 侯 represents the sound.
w: to get a monkey to perform tricks
x: 猴子爬上了树。
Hóuzi páshàng le shù.
The monkey climbed up a tree.
别猴急。
Bié hóují.
Hold your horses.

尴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 尢 represents the meaning and 监 represents the sound. Simplified form of 尷.
x: 当时没人说话，气氛很尴尬。
Dāngshí méi rén shuōhuà, qìfēn hěn gāngà.
Nobody spoke at the time, and the atmosphere was awkward.
他尴尬地笑了笑。
Tā gāngà de xiào le xiào.
He gave an embarrassed smile.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

缴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 敫 represents the sound. Simplified form of 繳.
w: to transfer (income, profits etc) to higher authorities
to disarm; to lay down one's weapons
x: 请在这个窗口缴费。
Qǐng zài zhège chuāngkǒu jiǎofèi.
Please pay at this window.
学生每年要缴纳学费。
Xuésheng měi nián yào jiǎonà xuéfèi.
Students have to pay tuition fees every year.

赴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 走 represents the meaning and 卜 represents the sound.
w: to do at all costs; to make an all-out effort
to go through water and tread on fire (idiom); not afraid of any…
to rush to; to hurry to
(of troops) to depart for; to head for
x: 他为人狡猾，我看你还是不要去赴那鸿门宴吧！
Tā wéirén jiǎohuá, wǒ kàn nǐ háishì bùyào qù fù nà hóngményàn ba!
He is treacherous, so I think you had better not accept his invitation.
那妇人满身珠光宝气地赴宴，引起众人的注目。
Nà fùrén mǎnshēn zhūguāngbǎoqì dì fùyàn, yǐnqǐ zhòngrén de zhùmù.
That woman went to the banquet dripped in jewels and attaracted everyone's attention.

黴.o: A small 微 black 黑 growth; 微 also provides the pronunciation
w: to have bad luck; to be out of luck

滴.o: Phonosemantic compound. 啇 represents the sound and 氵 represents the meaning.
w: bit by bit; dribs and drabs
bit by bit; every little bit
to drool with desire (idiom); to envy
x: 杯子里一滴水也没有了。
Bēizi li yī dī shuǐ yě méiyǒu le.
There isn't a single drop of water left in the cup.
雨滴打在窗户上。
Yǔdī dǎ zài chuānghu shang.
